schedule: Alternate A and B in seed-parity order in each phase. Initial punished target alternates across seed index; reversal punishes the other cue. Shuffled pulse sequence is permuted separately per phase with exact matching counts.
decoder: Fixed score = mean(MBON12) - mean(MBON01); prefer larger score, ties choose A. This engineered readout is not GF behavior or a neural probability.
conditioning: One simultaneous cue plus optional direct PPL103 stimulation per trial. Local learning reads measured KC and endogenous/stimulated DAN endpoint rates. Existing eight-step kernel restarts each presentation.
retention: Software memory persistence and non-invasive repeated probes only; no biological decay or elapsed-time model.
acceptance: Every seed must choose the safe cue after acquisition and reversal, with positive baseline-corrected effects. Reversal effect must exceed absent and shuffled controls across seeds (one-sided sign p<0.05). Disabled state/response unchanged; exact reset/restoration; fixed wiring and nonplastic parameters; matched pulse counts. All gates required. Failures preserved without tuning.
scope: Exposure-controlled synthetic association comparison for a coarse source-derived local rule. Not biological validation, autonomous exploration, chess learning, full-model adaptation, or transfer. Gamma4 V1/V2 remain separate failed experiments.
